title: A bill to designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 4558 Broadway in New York, New York, as the "Stanley Michels Post Office Building".
official_summary: (Sec. 1) Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 4558 Broadway in New York, New York, as the "Stanley Michels Post Office Building."

summary.headline: Congress named a New York City post office building after Stanley Michels, a ceremonial designation with no change to mail service.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames a United States Postal Service facility at 4558 Broadway in New York, New York, as the "Stanley Michels Post Office Building." It is an honorary naming measure. It does not change postal rules, fees, or services.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on July 30, 2018, and the naming took effect that day.
